name: Jiaqi Yin
title: Incoming Ph.D. Student
bio: I will begin my Ph.D. at Peking University’s School of Computer Science in Fall 2027, with [Prof. Tiejun Huang](https://idm.pku.edu.cn/info/1017/1040.htm) as my advisor. My research interests include embodied intelligence and world models.

news.content: Won 1st Place at the [2025 ASME Student Mechanism & Robot Design Competition](https://sites.google.com/site/asmemrc/design-competition-showcase) (Undergraduate Category).
Visiting student at [SSR Group, Tsinghua SIGS](https://ssr-group.net/).

opensource.title: OnTimeBench
opensource.description: OnTimeBench is a MuJoCo benchmark for dynamic robotic manipulation, with 14 tasks across five families and 1,400 held-out test scenes. The simulation advances during inference so each policy is evaluated at its native latency.
opensource.image_alt: Overview of the OnTimeBench benchmark and its 14 tasks

opensource.title: Octo UR5: Real-World Deployment of Octo on Universal Robots
opensource.description: A complete open-source pipeline for deploying the Octo embodied intelligence model on UR5/UR3 robots — simulation, teleoperation, data collection, finetuning, and distributed inference.

opensource.title: franka-control: Franka Research 3 Control Wrapper for Embodied AI
opensource.description: A lightweight control library that decouples high-level policy (RL/IL/VLA) from 1 kHz FCI real-time control. Supports single-machine and dual-machine (GPU cluster + control PC) deployment via ZeroMQ. Provides a Gymnasium-style reset()/step()/close() interface, multiple interpolators (Ruckig, PT1, CubicSpline), joystick teleoperation, and independent gripper service.
